name: Charlatan
body:
You are adept at swindling others by lying about the qualities of items.

Prerequisite(s): Cha 13, Appraise 3 ranks and Bluff 3 ranks

Benefit: When you lie about the qualities and/or properties of an item (magical or otherwise), you get a +4 bonus to your Bluff check. In addition, you may use Bluff as a Profession skill for purposes of earning an income for a week of dedicated work. However, you may not use Bluff to earn an income in the same place more than once per six months.
